summary.text: Wesley Hunt has served in the U.S. House since 2023 and sits on the Natural Resources and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Houston, he graduated from West Point in 2004 and spent eight years in the Army as an Apache helicopter pilot, including one deployment to Iraq.
After leaving the Army as a Captain he earned an MBA, a Master of Public Administration and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations at Cornell University.
